steps.label: Hochladen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && a=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -T ponzi_film3.mp4 -H "Content-Type: video/mp4" -H "If-None-Match: *" "$(cat vurl.txt)") && b=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -T ponzi_thumb.jpg -H "Content-Type: image/jpeg" -H "If-None-Match: *" "$(cat turl.txt)") && rm -f vurl.txt turl.txt && echo "video $a thumb $b" && [ "$a" = 200 ] && [ "$b" = 200 ]
